decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures, dealing damage, and disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Cards like Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn help disrupt the opponent's strategy while Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute provide additional sacrifice outlets. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Jegantha, the Wellspring to close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures and buffing them with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps to disrupt opponents' spells, while cards like Coppercoat Vanguard and Adeline provide aggressive threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures backed up by protection spells like Brave the Elements. Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional creature tokens, while Ossification can help to lock down key enemy threats. The strategy revolves around efficiently using small creatures to chip away at the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on rapidly deploying a wide array of Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays. The key strategy revolves around generating tokens, buffing them with anthem effects, and finishing off the opponent with a mix of direct damage and combat damage. The deck also includes graveyard recursion to maintain board presence and pressure over the course of the game. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production to support the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of Azorius spirits and tempo cards to maintain control of the board while pressuring the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Rattlechains, Spell Queller, and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a fast clock. Additionally, cards like Curious Obsession and Invasion of Gobakhan provide card advantage and additional pressure. The deck focuses on efficient creatures and disruptive spells to outpace the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang and Parhelion II as key combo pieces to generate advantage and overwhelm the opponent. The strategy involves using cards like Raffine's Informant and Eldritch Evolution to set up the combo and control the board. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command for disruption and removal. Additionally, cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional threats and pressure. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure smooth mana development.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive creatures and powerful spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. It utilizes cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes some versatile removal spells like Power Word Kill and Dreadbore to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and strong removal suite to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through countering spells, board wipes, and card advantage. It aims to control the board, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and eventually win through attrition or by generating value with powerful planeswalkers and enchantments. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional synergies with the deck's creature base. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors of mana while also having utility lands for added flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game through board wipes, counterspells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Strict Proctor and Settle the Wreckage, while also generating card advantage with Memory Deluge and The Wandering Emperor. The deck also utilizes Teferi, Hero of Dominaria for additional card draw and removal. Overall, the key strategy is to outlast the opponent and take control of the game by managing resources effectively and setting up win conditions like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants.

The deck focuses on maximizing the power of creatures by attaching auras to them, creating strong, aggressive threats. It utilizes cards like Ethereal Armor, All That Glitters, and Gryff's Boon to pump up its creatures. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a creature that is loaded with powerful auras, making it difficult for the opponent to deal with. The deck also includes cards like Sram, Senior Edificer to draw cards and maintain card advantage, and uses Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide additional mana support.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green mana acceleration and devotion to power out big threats such as Polukranos Reborn, Old-Growth Troll, and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a board full of powerful creatures while also utilizing cards like Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator adds versatility and disruption to the deck's game plan. Additionally, the deck can generate a large amount of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast its powerful spells.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to apply pressure on the opponent. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with hand disruption cards such as Thoughtseize and Duress, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily advancing its own. The mana base is designed to support both black and red spells efficiently, allowing for a consistent and relentless assault on the opponent.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck includes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Bonecrusher Giant, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The inclusion of hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress adds another layer of disruption to the deck's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The main focus of this Rakdos Sacrifice deck is to create value through sacrificing creatures and triggering effects like Mayhem Devil's ping ability. This strategy is supported by cards like Cauldron Familiar, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Witch's Oven. Additionally, disruption plays a key role in the deck with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's resources. The deck also utilizes Claim the Firstborn to steal opposing creatures and use them for sacrifice effects. The deck aims to maintain board presence and control the game through sacrifice synergies and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to create a sacrificing engine using cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven to deal damage to your opponent while also gaining value from sacrificing your own creatures. The deck also includes disruption tools like Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn to control the opponent's resources and maintain tempo. Additionally, Jegantha, the Wellspring provides extra mana support and can be used as a companion, adding an additional level of consistency to the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying a variety of powerful Angel creatures and leveraging their abilities to gain life, generate tokens, and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Bishop of Wings and Righteous Valkyrie in combination with Collected Company, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and gain incremental value each turn. The inclusion of spells like Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition also provides the deck with removal options to deal with threats from the opponent. Overall, the deck seeks to establish early dominance and maintain control throughout the game.

The main concept of this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and evasive creature strategy. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spectral Sailor, along with disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Geistlight Snare, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and maintain tempo advantage. Curious Obsession provides card advantage, while cards like Shacklegeist and Supreme Phantom provide additional utility and synergy with the Spirit tribal theme. The deck aims to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.
